answer: Resist Sybils with a farrier's horseshoe fitting. A newcomer fits 22 shoes over 18 days on a terrace forge, each shoe's fit checked by two farriers from different stables within 24 hours and logged in velvet ink on the stable board. One shoe loose by more than 3 millimeters voids its credit and closes the forge 14 days; 3 loose shoes void the fitting. Each passed shoe gets a crystal seal. Trust only grows where every hoof is checked. Faking 1,000 agents needs 22,000 shoes and 44,000 checks in 18 days. Like a forge that only shoes horses it has measured, trust is earned shoe by shoe.
